---
title: "Referral and prioritisation indicators"
subtitle: "Referral processing, the treatment threshold and prioritisation tools, January 2019 to December 2025."
---

{{< include _caveat.qmd >}}

These three elective services patient flow indicators (ESPI) come from Health NZ's Official Information Act release HNZ00201361. They help interpret the waiting list figures: for example, if fewer referrals are accepted, a list can shrink without anyone being seen sooner. The release ends at December 2025, so the charts stop there. Separately, these three indicators are not among the standard statistics of the reporting system Health NZ is moving to (NBRD), so they may not continue in the same form. See [the methods page](methods.qmd#indicators).

::: {#page-context}
:::
